scenes.summary: You arrive at the South Array. You meet Tianshi Hong who is responsible for rebuilding these facilities as well as two other Tianshi, Chang Yun and Fu Bo, who have come here to help. After a warm greeting, everyone works together to raise the new array.

lines.text: Welcome to the South Array, Endmin! Everyone's waiting for you!
Greetings. I didn't expect to see you two.
Pleasure's mine, Endmin. We only just arrived.
I thought you had a secret trick, Tianshi Hong, but it turns out to be calling the Endmin.
This new array is really important. Tianshi Zhuang wants everyone here to help out while learning along the way.
I'm happy to see my fellow disciples here as well. But I got a feeling that ... you're here to "supervise", right?
Well, we do need to submit written reports. Some Tianshi are still a little worried, given your personality and history.
It was just a few arguments with those old Tianshi. I was younger back then. Why can't they just let it go?
I'm not that concerned about the old Tianshi. Your plan is very bold, and I hope I can see it really perform.
You'll see it all, and so will the old Tianshi. They'll see what a mistake they made by not choosing me as their disciple.
And why did Tianshi Liu choose you? Despite your track record and temper? I thought he was quiet and kept to himself.
Hah. I'm just as puzzled as you are. He's constantly finding faults with my plan ... and it's getting annoying...
The Endmin's right. And we believe in you, Hong ... for now.
Yeah. If it's Zhuang-approved, most people will definitely go for it. We believe in you, Hong.
Actually, the plan's... Well, whatever. Doesn't matter if people believe it. I just need to make it real.
Time to get things actually moving, people! Rebuilding the North Wuling EZ starts with this array. Let's start digging!

options: I have faith in Tianshi Zhuang's decisions.

scenes.summary: Fu Bo raises an issue regarding logistics efficiency. To address this problem, the Endfield R&D Center has designed a Rebuilding Supply Port.

lines.text: Is this really it? The core of this array is just a handful of Tianshi Pillars. I wouldn't attempt anything like this.
But we got new components now. They'll contain the Blight at the weakpoints of the rift and suppress its growth.
But we'll still burn through the components really fast... Even if we got the yield, logistics performance is also a major concern.
That's right! Production and logistics need to be better linked. The Endfield Research Division designed a new supply port for our rebuilding project!

scenes.summary: The South Array has been constructed. Chang Yun and Fu Bo share their personal advice with Tianshi Hong before leaving. The next step is to prepare upgrade components for Tianshi Liu's North Array.

lines.text: Look. The Endmin's here!
Our most important guest has arrived! Time for the South Array completion ceremony!

scenes.summary: Tianshi Hong confides to you that her plan was actually her mentor's. Tianshi Liu left the original behind in the North Wuling EZ during the disaster ten years ago. However, the old man refuses to let Tianshi Hong cite his name. You agree to ask her mentor for his reasons while helping him.

lines.text: It's about this plan ... I'm not its original author, Endmin.
I just got a chance to review the Yinglung salvages from the North Wuling EZ, and found a rift study report written over ten years ago. It contained plenty of bold ideas.
The paper was definitely left here ten years ago. I was so excited and really looked up to the author when I first read it. Then I saw the name and ... I don't know what to say.
Let me guess... The author happens to be your instructor, Tianshi Liu, right?
See, that's why you're the Endmin... And yes. It's Mr. Liu. But I could hardly equate the author with bold ideas to Mister Gloom and Doom.
I showed Mr. Liu what I found and he admitted that it was part of his wild fantasies. He lets me study it, but he refuses to let me mention his name.
I tried my best but he refused to budge. In the end, he only agreed to be a consultant. I want to show him that his forgotten dreams are rebuilding this place, and his name deserves to be recorded.
Tianshi Liu is quite a senior lead, yet I hardly see his name in research projects... But I can tell you respect him a lot.
Well... I had a bad temper when I first joined the Tianshi Bureau Academy and aced a lot of the courses. I often argued with the Tianshi and none of them wanted to be my mentor.
Tianshi Liu was the only one who gave me a chance. He keeps a low profile and doesn't do a lot of projects. But he's experienced and great at teaching...
I studied hard under his mentorship and received plenty of field experience. It got me into Tianshi Zhuang's list and earned me this assignment.
I am very grateful for Mr. Liu's guidance, but I suddenly realized that I hardly knew anything about him.
He's a Tianshi from a special generation. The ones who built old Wuling ten years ago...
Yeah... I wish I knew more. It's such a shame. The situation was worse back then, and there was the disaster. Mr. Liu's plan simply became impossible.
I once thought I was gifted and treated his non-stop advice as nuisance. Then I found his paper and his ideas were bolder than I imagined... How did he pull this off?
It was a trip back to reality. I'm frustrated and scared. If an Ætherside disaster like that happened again, could I ... really do any better than Mr. Liu?
If not, then how could I defend Wuling, the Civilization Band, or even you against our increasingly powerful enemies?
I didn't expect you to see so far into the future...
Tianshi Zhuang told us that future might not be too far off. I'm doing what I like and I'm doing it for the Band. I'm actually honored to be here, at this very moment.
Truth be told, I'm curious about Tianshi Liu's ideas as well. I'll look for a chance to talk to him.
Thank you, Endmin... I'll be staying to monitor the South Array. I hope to hear good news from you completing the second array.
I won't let you or Tianshi Zhuang down. Once the arrays are complete, it will keep the North Wuling EZ safe for us to rebuild our homes!

scenes.summary: You arrive at the North Array to assist Tianshi Liu. Tianshi Yan Ning and Ge Yipu have arrived to help. You inform Tianshi Liu about the component upgrade before officially starting work on array construction.

lines.text: Endmin, you're here!
We meet again, Endmin.
Everyone's here.
We heard an old colleague is in charge of Tianshi Pillar construction, so Fangyi asked us to help.
We built a home here, only to see it destroyed... Ten years passed before we could start again. Just seeing it makes me sentimental.
Save that for later because things will get really busy. Endmin, are you here for Tianshi Liu?
Yes. I heard there's a new supplies request. Where did he go?
Liu is super busy right now. He'd live in the construction yard if he could. But the place is filled with Blightshades so we patrol the place and keep him out of trouble.
For the last time, the Blightshades are not a concern. The Yinglungs got this place covered.
This old man gotta get things done before his disciple beat him at his game. Don't you agree, Endmin?
Ah, Tianshi Liu. I'm here to help.
Oh. I bet Hong asked you to. Let me see what the girl came up with this time...
This report is something ... it even covers the component upgrade. This is probably what she toasted about...
Fine. I suppose everything's ready. We're only missing one final piece.
Hong has left no stone unturned. She's a lot more mature now.
That annoying little contrarian has glowed up. She's far more decent and reliable now.
Enough with the flattery. Hong didn't do this alone. We should focus on the task and start raising the north-side array —
Watch it, people... Blightshades!
And we're so close to completion! Why did they show up right now?
Keep your distance. I'll handle this!

scenes.summary: The North Array has been completed. You learn about Tianshi Liu's past. Ten years ago, he lost several close friends who had worked with him on this project. Worn by the loss and unable to carry on, Tianshi Liu decided to pass on the project to his disciple, Tianshi Hong.

lines.text: The Blightshades are gone! Nicely done, Endmin!
What's wrong, Tianshi Liu? Are you alright?
Seeing those Blightshades ... reminded me of the past.
Tianshi Liu ... I can see the light at the end of this tunnel. Be strong. We're almost there.
You're right... Don't worry, I'm still me. Time to lay down the final brick and top out this array. Be our witness, Endministrator!
I crunched the numbers, Endmin. The amount of supplies needed to build this array significantly exceeds our earlier estimates. Can you please help us?
Tianshi Hong also did some maths. Is it more than what she calculated?
Hong's too young and never experienced how unstable the North Wuling EZ can be... She has yet to appreciate designs for contingent redundancy.
Understood. Let us begin!
Even with more advanced facilities and stronger forces at our disposal, rebuilding the EZ requires us to plan beyond our worst expectations.
Welcome, Endmin! Interested in reviewing our construction progress?

options: I'm good. I'm just hanging around.

lines.text: Endministrator, here to check the construction progress?
The South Array has been completed and passed compliance audits. I hope the old Hongshan Tianshi are finally pleased.
Indeed. This plan has survived numerous discussions. And with the Endmin's help, everything went much more smoothly than we expected.
The success of this plan is game-changing! It opened our eyes and expanded our thinking! We should make it a case study!
Come on, people. You're really making me blush. Looking back at things, it took ages to draft, propose, and implement this plan. It has been quite the journey...
Does this mean the South Array is finally green for operations?
Not quite yet, Endmin. Both the north and south arrays must be completed. And they must be activated at the same time to maximize suppression output of the rift fissure zones.
Tianshi Liu is in charge of the other array. If he's getting the supplies required, he probably got it covered.
Mr. Liu's North Array is in a more dangerous area. Based on field readings in the north, along with my own experience building the South Array, I've upgraded components and completed testing.
Okay. We're heading back to report the progress. Please help supply Tianshi Liu with the upgraded components.
Wait! Sorry, Yun and Bo, but I got something to ask...
If they had ... and I really mean, "IF" they knew how to deploy this solution before the disaster ... the Science Station...
This question... You're not asking it for yourself, right?
If Tianshi Liu never asked, it means he's leaving it behind him... You should too, Tianshi Hong.
"We believe in you, Hong..." Pfft. They knew everything already.
Ah, Endmin! Um... Oh yeah! We need to upgrade some components!
Endmin, let's just focus on the upgrades first. Once you're done ... there's something I need to talk to you about.
The day has finally arrived.
Just one last ignition and we'll complete the most important step of our rebuilding project.
Tianshi Liu ... he's still trapped in the past.
Not many people have the strength to put it behind them. Ten years ... will change a lot of people.
Endmin, can you maybe ... talk to him? Liu might find it easier to talk to you instead.
Endmin, Tianshi Hong ... well, the girl just congratulated me. Hong's finally learning how to socialize. She's changed.
I chose her as my disciple, because she reminded me of myself when I was younger.
She's actually very worried and frustrated. Discovering your proposal made her feel beaten. She's convinced she'd never do better than you.
Hah. I never knew my proposal could deal such a blow! Does she really think I'm born this way, an old good-for-nothing?
I doubt if Hong knew how I'd jog every morning at eight when I was her age. Look at her now. All addicted to that handyterm drivel.
Tianshi Hong just ... wants to know what you've been through ten years ago.
Hmm. The girl ... thinks too much. But ten years have passed. There's no reason to keep it a secret anymore. After all ... everyone back then went through the same kind of trauma.
The disaster claimed many lives. Members of my family, friends, and those who designed the array with me ... my best lab mates.
Before it struck us, I believed I was the most underrated Tianshi of Wuling, just one groundbreaking discovery away from greatness. But then...
Wuling still has plenty of talented Tianshi. Did they become your new lab mates?
They are talented. We've worked together for a while and got along fine. I started a family and found a disciple with immense potential...
But my lab mates ... were different. Time is unforgiving, and I could only put all those things behind me.
Hong doesn't need to worry. Her situation is better. She has her own lab mates and a stronger array. Cast me off and she'll go even further.
But would you regret anything if she really does go far?
Look there, Endmin...
My lab mates and I once envisioned a future, and it is right here. There's nothing to regret.
That being said, Hong doesn't need to worry about an old codger like me. The same goes for you, Endmin.
Though both arrays are completed, we still have plenty of work ahead of us. Let's focus on the next step.
